text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Yasuda Kinen, the<n>race that
determines the spring King<n>of the Mile...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The rain is really coming down today!<n>The track is
completely soaked.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I think this might be too much for Taiki<n>Shuttle to
handle.

There's a lot of concern brewing<n>around whether
Taiki Shuttle can<n>perform well in these conditions.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the weather's not looking so hot<n>today. Gray
skies and not a lick o'<n>sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I ain't bothered one bit! I'm<n>ready for anything,
come hell or high<n>water!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My heart's burnin' so hot, that rain'll<n>turn straight
into steam around me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I tell ya what! I'm gonna show the<n>crowd some real
good runnin' to get<n>'em all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It'll take more than a few raindrops to<n>dampen my
power and speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I will! Make sure ya root me on!
